fixed: In the last shot the sleeping farmer ran off the edge of the narrow frame. In a wide shot the camera now keeps the whole of anyone holding a pose in the picture, and still does when a push-in has finished.
notes: At the gate, when he says he has something of the queen's, the vertical frame shows him alone; the soldier's surprise is in the wide cut only.
The night street is seen from so close in the vertical cut that it is mostly a house wall: the moon and the sky are out of the picture.
He sleeps on the bare floor: no bed is drawn.
When the queen gives him gold, a coin appears in his hand while she is out of the picture.
